scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Complete index census, top-level multiplicity and group-order invariance; no claim to priority for classical DAG enumeration.
scientific_integrity.computational_scope: Independent graph census n<=4 for g in {1,2,4}; direct subset product enumeration for seven listed small cases.
scientific_integrity.proof_scope: All n>=1 and all finite groups G (order g>=1), using canonical height layers and Brandt multiplication.

scientific_limitations: Finite Brandt semigroups with arbitrary finite group, n at least one, and nonempty subsets; not all finite semigroups.
The DAG correspondence for aperiodic Brandt semigroups, classical DAG totals, and binary-relation nilpotence enumeration predate this work.
The McKay 1989 source on DAG longest-path height was accessible only through its abstract, leaving implicit-coverage risk.
Finite enumeration uses cyclic groups; universality across all finite group structures is proved symbolically.
title: Exact nilpotency-index census of finite Brandt power semigroups
